vertical_structure.instructions: Grade the skill's ARTIFACT DESIGN (vertical axis) on structure: progressive disclosure (lean root, deep refs), one-level-deep references, clean directory layout, no redundant navigation layers. 1=broken structure, 2=working but wasteful, 3=sound, 4=exemplary.

vertical_token_efficiency.instructions: Grade token efficiency (vertical axis): is every line earning its context cost? Penalize restating what the model already knows, filler, duplication across files. 1=verbose, 2=mixed, 3=tight, 4=maximal signal density.

vertical_navigability.instructions: Grade navigability (vertical axis): could a fresh agent, given only this skill, find the right file for its task on the first try? Nav tables, reading orders, descriptive file names. 1=lost, 2=eventual, 3=clear, 4=effortless.
criteria: effortless routing to the right file

vertical_actionability.instructions: Grade actionability (vertical axis): can the agent ACT, not just read? Runnable code, lifted-wholesale examples, scripts, copyable banks. 1=prose only, 2=partial recipes, 3=runnable, 4=turnkey.

vertical_convention.instructions: Grade convention adherence (vertical axis): frontmatter quality, third person, no anti-patterns (nested refs, magic numbers, time-sensitive facts unmarked, second person). 1=many violations, 2=some, 3=clean, 4=exemplary.

horizontal_coverage.instructions: Grade intended-use COVERAGE (horizontal axis): does the skill actually deliver its stated purpose for BOTH narrow problems (one decision) and wide systems (many flows)? 1=narrow band only, 2=main cases, 3=broad, 4=truly general.

horizontal_method.instructions: Grade method completeness (horizontal axis): is the path from problem statement to shipped, evaluated feature unbroken? Any step an agent would stall on counts against. 1=gaps stall the agent, 2=mostly complete, 3=complete, 4=complete and hard to misuse.

horizontal_correctness.instructions: Grade correctness (horizontal axis): are API claims, limits, and technical assertions accurate as stated? 1=contains real errors, 2=a few shaky claims, 3=accurate, 4=accurate and staleness-marked.

horizontal_teachability.instructions: Grade teachability (horizontal axis): would a fresh agent with this skill ALONE succeed at the task it teaches, on the first attempt? 1=needs lots of outside knowledge, 2=needs some, 3=self-sufficient, 4=self-sufficient and self-correcting.

horizontal_self_hosting.instructions: Grade self-hosting (horizontal axis): does the skill practice what it preaches (use its own tools, ship working assets, demonstrate its method on itself)? Lowest=purely preachy, highest=fully self-hosted.

gap_missing_runnable_assets.instructions: The skill lacks runnable assets (an example question bank, frozen eval cases, or a sample state) that would let an agent execute immediately without inventing file formats.

gap_missing_test_mocking.instructions: The skill lacks guidance on testing code that depends on it: recorded/canned answers, fixtures, replay, or stubbing the API in CI.

gap_missing_governance.instructions: The skill lacks governance guidance: question banks treated as versioned code artifacts, eval-gated changes, review discipline for prompt-like content.

gap_missing_cost_model.instructions: The skill lacks a token/cost model: how to estimate spend per call or per structure (state tokens x price, fan-out cost, chain cost).

gap_missing_glossary.instructions: The skill lacks a glossary or quick term reference for its own vocabulary (primitive names, field names, jargon).

gap_missing_troubleshooting.instructions: The skill lacks a troubleshooting/symptom-to-fix section for common failures (mid nouls, low confidence, wrong branch, timeouts).

has_redundancy.instructions: The skill has meaningful redundant content: the same guidance stated in two+ files, or a navigation layer duplicating another.

has_staleness_risk.instructions: The skill contains time-sensitive claims (versions, prices, dates) NOT marked as snapshots or verified-at-date, risking silent staleness.

weakest_area.instructions: Which area most needs improvement in this skill?

criteria.stronger_evaluation: eval assets, calibration examples, verification templates
criteria.broader_coverage: use cases or patterns currently missing

overall.instructions: Overall grade for the skill as a shipping artifact: 1=needs rework, 2=usable with gaps, 3=solid, 4=reference-quality.
